audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing was right but rested on unnamed abilities.
audit.why: 55.88% over 1378 games at Emerald+ is a comfortable-even lane; the swing point is Galio's Shield of Durand taunt, not his Justice Punch alone.
audit.corrected: Kept EVEN / 6-10, re-anchored the reasoning to Shield of Durand (18/17/16/15/14s) and Justice Punch (11/10/9/8/7s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Galio's level 6 without the cooldown that decides whether you can spend Ragnarok.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s and Galio's R is 180/160/140s — the longest cooldowns in the lane, so both are commit-only buttons.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states Ragnarok's disable immunity, that it only holds while he keeps attacking, and its 100s cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings credited Olaf's W with lifesteal / omnivamp ('W-sustain', 'W omnivamp', 'W for attack-speed and lifesteal').
audit.why: Olaf's W is attack speed plus a SHIELD in Riot's text — no healing. The lifesteal is the passive, which scales with MISSING health.
audit.corrected: Healing reassigned to the passive (Berserker Rage) and made a reason to commit rather than poke; W restated as attack speed plus shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Galio's Justice Punch is a dash, and Olaf's Undertow grounds.
audit.why: Grounding shuts off dashes, so an axe under Galio removes his only repositioning tool for the trade — and Undertow's 9s cooldown refunds fully on pickup.
audit.corrected: Written into tldr, winCon, tradeGood and whys[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Text claimed Justice Punch 'can't stop Ragnarok' — the CC that matters is the taunt, not the knockup.
audit.why: Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking; Shield of Durand's taunt is the disable that would otherwise end the run-down. Knockup/displacement behaviour under Ragnarok is not stated in Riot's text, so it is not asserted here.
audit.corrected: Claims re-pointed at Shield of Durand's taunt; no knockup-immunity claim made.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the entry.
audit.why: Justice Punch 11s at rank 1, Shield of Durand 18s at rank 1 (14s maxed), Undertow 9s with a full reset on pickup.
audit.corrected: Numbers placed in winCon, tradeGood, early and mid.

edits.after: Ground Justice Punch with Undertow and run him down — Ragnarok ignores his Shield of Durand taunt.

edits.after: Galio's R is a global engage; Shield of Durand taunts, but Ragnarok's disable immunity holds while you keep attacking.

edits.before: Galio's R is a global engage and his W taunt + damage reduction is his one window to flip an all-in, so respect the taunt before you dive.
edits.after: Ragnarok at 6 shrugs off Shield of Durand's taunt while you keep swinging, but it is a 100s cooldown — spend it on a kill, not on poke.

edits.before: Galio is an immobile melee-range tank with no escape until his W, which is exactly the kind of target Olaf eats. Lead with Q to slow him, then walk up and weave E's true damage in — his base armor and his W damage-reduction shield do nothing against true damage. The one thing to watch is his W taunt: if you all-in while it's up he reduces your damage and locks you walking the wrong way, so bait it or trade when it's on cooldown. His Q wind-blast poke is real but your W omnivamp heals it right back.
edits.after: Galio's only exit is Justice Punch, an 11-second dash — Undertow grounds it, so drop the axe under him and he cannot step back. Lead with the slow, walk the pickup for the free reset, then weave Reckless Swing in: it is true damage, so his base armor and Shield of Durand's damage reduction do nothing to it. Watch that same W though — the taunt walks you the wrong way, so bait it or trade on its 18s cooldown. His Winds of War poke is real, and your lifesteal grows as your health drops, not from W.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Pick up your axe to refund Q and keep him permanently slowed, W for attack-speed and lifesteal in the extended fight, and E true damage straight through whatever MR he's building. At 6 his R is a global engage, not a 1v1 button, and his W taunt is his only real flip — so dodge or pre-empt the taunt and you run him down. First item (Bramble/Cleaver core) is your hardest oppression window: he simply can't out-trade or out-sustain you here.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Pick up the axe to refund Undertow and keep him permanently slowed, press Tough It Out for attack speed and its shield, and let Reckless Swing's true damage cut whatever MR he builds — your lifesteal climbs the lower you get. At 6 his R is a global engage, not a 1v1 button, and Shield of Durand is his only flip, so bait the taunt on its 14s cooldown and run him down. First item is your hardest oppression window.

edits.before: Reset your axe to perma-slow him and W-omnivamp through his Q poke
edits.after: Reset the axe on pickup and shield Winds of War with Tough It Out
